status_reasoning: Registered as OBSERVE, not pre_registered, because the prior evidence is NEGATIVE and this programme does not launder a failed backtest into a forward pod. The published claim (PF 1.479, WR 50.2%) is UNREPRODUCED: measured PF ~1.00, WR 40.6%, random-entry null 69.8th percentile, selection-alpha CI-LB -0.285%. A pod that could not fail would be theatre.

hypothesis.name: equity breakout with limit fills
hypothesis.statement: Daily breakout continuation, entered with LIMIT orders that fill only if the next bar trades through the signal price, beats a T-bill hurdle after cost
hypothesis.why_limit_fills_are_the_point: the published break-even is 24.59 bp/side while measured next-bar-open entry at 5 bp/side still gives PF 1.22; a limit entry lowers the effective cost and is the only untested execution variant that could change the cell

prior_evidence.killed_by: random-entry null and negative selection alpha, NOT by cost
prior_evidence.consequence: improving fills cannot rescue a rule that is indistinguishable from random entry; this pod exists to test whether forward LIMIT fills nonetheless produce a positive excess, and it must report the null comparison beside every result

execution.entry: LIMIT at the signal bar's high (long) or low (short); filled ONLY if a later bar trades through it within 3 sessions, else the signal expires unfilled
execution.unfilled_reporting: the fill rate MUST be reported; a limit rule that fills 12% of the time is a different strategy from one that fills 80%, and a favourable result with a 12% fill rate is a selection effect
execution.exit: 1x ATR stop / 2x ATR target / 24-bar time stop, first touch
execution.tie_break: conservative: stop before target when both are touched intraday

size_gate.reason: the backtest had 1,935 trades; 50 forward fills is the minimum that can speak to a 0.49% per-trade edge

kill_rule.trigger: at n>=50 forward fills: PF < 1.0 OR random-entry null percentile < 95 OR fill rate < 30%
kill_rule.then: record REFUTED and close the pod; do not re-register the same rule under a new id

promotion_rule.trigger: n>=50 AND PF >= 1.22 at 5 bp/side AND null >= 95 AND fill rate >= 30%
promotion_rule.then: CANDIDATE only; capital requires a second universe

known_limitations: equity cost is UNMEASURED (11 bp/side assumed in the pod, 5 bp/side in the backtest)
the 13-symbol universe is today's-constituents, so survivorship flatters breakouts
the published PF 1.479 must never be quoted as prior support: it is UNREPRODUCED
